description:
Change what a segment is. No render is ever lost: what a change
replaces goes to the bin.

combine: merge with a neighboring segment. The kept segment's prompts
and renders stay over the combined length (a clip too short plays over
its image; B-roll too short is refused); the other's go to the bin. Its
sound effects and overlays join the kept segment.

change_type: to an image, real photo or B-roll (both fetched). Clips
and talking heads come from render action=animate. keep_image turns a
clip back into its image, keeping the render. The prompts carry over
unchanged; render the segment again. A real photo or B-roll takes the
searches it had before; one that had none gets them written by a small
AI step in the background, which writes only its searches and spends
credits (get_status wait=true); it renders once that finishes.

rewrite: an AI rewrite of the prompts from feedback, in the background:
a small AI step that spends credits (get_status wait=true); render the
image and clip again after. For exact text, use segment_edit
set_prompts.

Sound effects and overlays always survive; change an overlay's text
with editor_edit scene_note. Later segments may renumber: read the
storyboard again.

action.description: combine: with_segment_number, optional keep; change_type: to, optional keep_image; rewrite: feedback

feedback.description: rewrite: what to change, e.g. "make this a close-up"

keep.description: combine: whose prompts and renders survive

keep_image.description: change_type from a clip to image: keep the rendered image

title: Restructure a segment
